# Verification using Chinese Remainder Theorem (different method)
# 464 = 16 * 29

# Calculate 13^765 modulo each prime factor separately
mod_16 = pow(13, 765, 16)
mod_29 = pow(13, 765, 29)

# Use CRT to combine: find x where x ≡ mod_16 (mod 16) and x ≡ mod_29 (mod 29)
inv_29_mod_16 = pow(29, -1, 16)
inv_16_mod_29 = pow(16, -1, 29)

# Apply CRT formula
result = (mod_16 * 29 * inv_29_mod_16 + mod_29 * 16 * inv_16_mod_29) % 464

print(f"ANSWER: {result}")
